content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a change in the code that incorrectly referenced a resource directory without the proper file extension. Specifically, the code was attempting to load resources using the name "cmsFreemarkerTransforms" instead of the correct name "cmsFreemarkerTransforms.properties". This oversight likely led to a failure in locating the intended properties file, resulting in errors when the application tried to access the necessary configurations for Freemarker transformations. The patch corrects this by specifying the correct file name with the .properties extension.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a change in the code that incorrectly referenced a resource directory without the proper file extension. Specifically, the code was attempting to load resources using the name "cmsFreemarkerTransforms" instead of the correct name "cmsFreemarkerTransforms.properties". This oversight likely led to a failure in locating the intended properties file, resulting in errors when the application tried to access the necessary configurations for Freemarker transformations. The patch corrects this by specifying the correct file name with the .properties extension.
Patch:
From dd404c353400efb5080430e068763bf84748f2fd Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Pascal Proulx <pplx@ilscipio.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2018 15:34:32 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] cms: fix .properties extension bug introduced in 2892ce1c339

---
 .../src/com/ilscipio/scipio/cms/template/CmsRenderTemplate.java | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applications/cms/src/com/ilscipio/scipio/cms/template/CmsRenderTemplate.java b/applications/cms/src/com/ilscipio/scipio/cms/template/CmsRenderTemplate.java
index 545d03daf..26d09742f 100644
--- a/applications/cms/src/com/ilscipio/scipio/cms/template/CmsRenderTemplate.java
+++ b/applications/cms/src/com/ilscipio/scipio/cms/template/CmsRenderTemplate.java
@@ -187,7 +187,7 @@ public interface CmsRenderTemplate extends Serializable {
             ClassLoader loader = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
             Enumeration<URL> resources;
             try {
-                resources = loader.getResources("cmsFreemarkerTransforms");
+                resources = loader.getResources("cmsFreemarkerTransforms.properties");
             } catch (IOException e) {
                 Debug.logError(e, "Could not load list of cmsFreemarkerTransforms", module);
                 throw UtilMisc.initCause(new InternalError(e.getMessage()), e);
